title: Maestría en Administración y Políticas Públicas
about: Universidad de San Andrés opened 2027 registrations for its Master's in Public Administration and Public Policy on 1 August 2026. An early-admission cut-off is 1 December 2026; final registrations close 23 February 2027, with classes starting 6 March 2027.

card_alt: Card for the Maestría en Administración y Políticas Públicas at Universidad de San Andrés (UdeSA), Buenos Aires, Argentina, with a 23 Feb 2027 application deadline. The photo shows the green-domed Palace of the Argentine National Congress in Buenos Aires at sunset.
